summary: Triggers: authored condition-to-effect rules the island runs at one point in the tick, applied as a transaction and recorded in the save

coordination.notes: Implemented. Conditions and effects are closed enums over state that already exists, so no condition can read and no effect can write something the simulation does not own. Evaluated at the settled tail of advance_island_tick, immediately before the campaign clock's own arbitration, so a trigger's effect (a recorded heat event, a faction turned hostile) is visible to the clock in the same tick; a pre-tick pass would re-fire on load. A trigger is a transaction: trigger_effects_applicable checks every effect before advance_triggers applies any of them, so a partially-refused firing cannot leave the world half-changed and the trigger stays pending for a tick where it can fully apply. fired_triggers (trigger ID to firing tick) and flags (a BTreeSet<String> a trigger's set_flag writes) are play state, saved, capped, and refused by name if a save claims a trigger the rule set no longer declares or a firing tick past the world's own. grant_item gets its first declared source, closing the noodle the items lane recorded: it was reachable only from a test. set_hostility(true) ends any survival truce between the pair as part of the same effect, preserving the load-time invariant that a truce pair is never hostile. No journal: the snapshot's flags entry is the only thing a trigger's effect exposes, read like any other board fact, never a line of narrated text.
